source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of bridging the digital divide (PDF 184-185).

blocks.text: Digital divide ko bridge karne (faasla kam karne) ka matlab hai yeh yaqeeni banana ke har shakhs ko technology aur internet tak barabar rasai ho. Yeh is liye zaroori hai ke sab ko seekhne aur aage barhne ke ek jaise mauqe milein. Is ke kuch tareeqe yeh hain:

items: Government Initiatives (hukumat ke iqdamat): Hukumat un ilaqon mein internet ke liye zaroori infrastructure bana sakti hai jahan yeh maujood nahi. Misal: Pakistan mein Universal Service Fund (USF) un dehaat aur door daraz ilaqon tak internet pohanchane ka kaam karta hai jahan logon ko pehle rasai nahi thi.

Educational Programs (taleemi programs): School aur community centers logon ko technology istemal karna sikha sakte hain. Misal: Digital literacy programs students aur bare logon ko parhai aur rozmarra kaamon ke liye computer aur internet istemal karna sikhate hain.

Public-Private Partnerships (hukumat aur private idaron ki shirakat): Jab hukumat businesses aur nonprofits (ghair munafa idaron) ke saath mil kar kaam karti hai to technology ko sasta (affordable) bana sakti hai. (Kitab is tareeqe ki misal nahi deti.)

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Hukumat-e-Pakistan ne dehi ilaqon mein internet ki rasai barhane ke liye kai iqdamat kiye hain, jin mein door daraz ilaqon mein mobile broadband services shuru karna bhi shamil hai. In koshishon ke bawajood kai ilaqon mein ab bhi qabil-e-aitbaar internet connection nahi, jo batata hai ke digital divide kam karna ab bhi ek jari challenge hai.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Apni community (ilaqe) ke bare mein sochein. Kya wahan aise log hain jinhein internet ya digital devices tak rasai nahi? Un ki madad ke liye kya kiya ja sakta hai? Ek chhota paragraph likhein ke aap ka school ya community digital divide kam karne mein kaise madad kar sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: Digital divide ko bridge karne ka matlab samjhaiye, aur Pakistan ki misalon ke saath government initiatives ka kirdar bataiye. (Long question 2)
blocks.explanation: Digital divide bridge karne ka matlab hai ke sab ko technology aur internet tak barabar rasai mile, ta ke sab ko seekhne aur aage barhne ke ek jaise mauqe milein. Hukumat ka kirdar bunyadi hai, kyunke woh un ilaqon mein infrastructure bana sakti hai jahan internet nahi. Pakistan ki misalein: Universal Service Fund (USF) dehaat aur door daraz ilaqon tak internet services pohanchata hai, aur hukumat ne door daraz ilaqon mein mobile broadband services shuru ki hain. Hukumat digital literacy programs aur businesses aur nonprofits ke saath shirakat (public-private partnerships) ke zariye technology sasti bhi kar sakti hai. Kitab ke mutabiq in koshishon ke bawajood kai ilaqon mein ab bhi qabil-e-aitbaar connection nahi, is liye yeh kaam jari rehna chahiye.

blocks.prompt: Class Activity: Aap ka school ya community digital divide kam karne mein kaise madad kar sakti hai? Ek chhota paragraph likhein.
blocks.explanation: Misal ke taur par (apne ilaqe ke mutabiq likhein): school ki computer lab chhutti ke din walidain aur parosiyon ke liye khol sakte hain; bare students buzurgon aur doosron ko phone aur internet ki bunyadi baatein sikha sakte hain; aur purane computer ya phone theek kar ke un khandanon ko de sakte hain jin ke paas device nahi.

items: Bridging: sab ko technology aur internet tak barabar rasai.
Tareeqe: government initiatives (USF), educational programs (digital literacy), public-private partnerships (sasti technology).
